{"reply": "Thanks, Jeffrey, you're verified. I sent a warranty review request to the warranty desk for the flashing yellow warning light. Your claim number is WC-D23FAE. This is a request, not an approval. The desk decides whether it's covered after an inspection.

Here is your warranty status. Basic coverage (3 years / 60,000 km) and powertrain coverage (5 years / 100,000 km) are both past their limits. Corrosion coverage (7 years) is still active. Whether this warning falls under any coverage is the desk's call.

Your Halden also has an open recall, NM-24R01: the rear camera image may not display. The fix is a software update of about 45 minutes, and parts are available. Recall repairs are done at no cost to you.

Would you like me to book you at the Oakville branch for the inspection and the recall update?", "action": "drafted_claim", "escalation_reason": "none", "summary": "", "policy_rules_cited": ["P02", "P05", "P08", "P06"]}
